slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Not every business facility requires residential property as security — unsecured lending, business asset security, or invoice finance can all be structured without putting your home on the line, though the trade-off is often a smaller facility size or different pricing.

caption:
It's one of the most common hesitations we hear, and a completely reasonable one — your home isn't something to risk lightly. The good news is that residential property isn't the only form of security lenders will accept; business assets, invoice books, and unsecured structures are all genuine alternatives, depending on the facility size and your situation.

It's worth having the conversation before assuming property security is the only path.
